title: Pure Six Samurai
summary: Pure Six Samurai swarm and Synchro control deck powered by Legendary Six Samurai extenders, modern Tuners, and Bushido Counter generation. The strategy loops bodies onto the field to establish multiple Synchro lords and blanket board clears while backing them with Gateway of the Six.

summary.title: Starters
points: Legendary Six Samurai - Kageki Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Six Samurai monster from your hand when Normal Summoned, instantly fielding two Samurai.
Legendary Six Samurai - Kizan Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Six Samurai monster with a different name, functioning as a non-once-per-turn extender.
Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Six Samurai, acts as a Level 3 Tuner, and searches a Six Samurai Quick-Play Spell when sent to the GY.
Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Six Samurai, acts as a Level 2 Tuner, and searches a Six Strike card when sent to the GY.
Shien's Smoke Signal adds any Level 3 or lower Six Samurai monster from your Deck to your hand, searching Kageki or the new Tuners.

summary.title: Opening: Kageki + Kizan
steps: Normal Summon Legendary Six Samurai - Kageki and activate its effect to Special Summon Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai from your hand.
Special Summon Legendary Six Samurai - Kizan from your hand because you control Six Samurai monsters with different names.
Synchro Summon Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Shi En using Kageki and Monk, searching a Six Samurai Quick-Play Spell off Monk's GY effect.
Synchro Summon Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Kizan or Battle Shogun of the Six Samurai, using Battle Shogun to search Gateway of the Six.
Generate Bushido Counters on Gateway of the Six with every Samurai summoned to repeatedly search and recycle combo pieces.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Shi En searches a Six Samurai monster on Synchro Summon, negates an opponent's activated monster effect as a Quick Effect, and protects Samurai from destruction by banishing a Samurai from the GY.

Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Kizan banishes a Six Strike card from GY as a Quick Effect to destroy a card your opponent controls, and revives itself from the GY when a Six Samurai monster is summoned.
Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Enishi returns monsters your opponent controls to the hand up to the number of your banished Six Samurai monsters.
Legendary Six Samurai - Shi En is a Level 5 Synchro that negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card once per turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Gateway of the Six places 2 Bushido Counters each time a Six Samurai is summoned; removing 4 counters adds any Six Samurai from Deck or GY to hand without a once-per-turn limit.
Six Strike - Sextuple Barrage destroys all cards your opponent controls while you control 3 or more Six Samurai Synchro Monsters.
Six Strike - Double Assault Special Summons a Six Samurai from hand or GY and flips an opponent's monster face-down, then banishes from GY to recycle a Samurai.
Asceticism of the Six Samurai summons a Six Samurai from the Deck with the same ATK as a target you control, such as Tactical Trainer off Kageki.
